text:
marta: heads up — saw a latency regression on dedicated today, traced to kernel selection shifting for long-seqlen chat workloads. logs attached below.

rui: can you paste the pick log lines? curious which reason flags flipped.

marta: here's a trimmed snippet from the pick trace (RK_PICK_TRACE=1):
```
time=2024-11-02T09:12:34Z pid=4221 request_id=abc123 model=rwkv-14b seq_len=1024 batch=1 hw=mlp-gpu-32
selected_kernel=matmul_quant_avx2 reason_bits=SEQ_BUCKET_HIGH|LOW_MEMORY_SCORE decision_score=0.42
fallback_path=soft_gemm_tf32 kv_cache_hit_rate=0.12 warmup_tokens=0
env_flags=RK_USE_ARCH_HINT=1 RK_KV_PREFETCH=0 RK_BATCH_STRICT=1
```

sam: interesting — decision_score 0.42 suggests the pick heuristic barely preferred the quant avx2 path. kv_cache_hit_rate 0.12 is low so perf hit expected for big seq.

anne: what telemetry are we emitting for this? we need kernel_choice + reason_bits + seq_bucket + kv_hit_rate per request. also hardware_tier.

marta: current telemetry: kernel_choice, reason_bits, seq_bucket. missing kv_hit_rate and decision_score in honeycomb. there are debug-only fields in RK_PICK_TRACE but not in production metrics.

rui: two quick ideas: 1) emit kv_hit_rate as a histogram (0-1) and tie it to seq_bucket, 2) add a 'pick_confidence' gauge derived from decision_score so rollups show borderline picks.

sam: we should also check the arch hints mapping — recent kernel build changed the arch label from avx2->avx2v_ext and our hint matcher stopped matching, so fallback triggered different cost model. i ran grep over the kernel registry and found one entry where arch_hint != kernel_label.

marta: oh that explains it — build infra rename from last week. i'll file a tiny fix but we still want safer telemetry so we can alert when arch_hint mismatch occurs.

anne: alert proposal: fire when (kernel_choice != expected_by_hint) AND (pick_confidence < 0.5) for >= 50 requests in 5m. tag by model and hw.

ops-bot: deploy-alert: canary cluster saw 57 mismatched kernel picks in last 5m for model=rwkv-14b. alert_id=A-20241102-19

marta: perfect repro steps i used: run bench client with --seq 1024 --batch 1 --warmup 50 sending synthetic tokens matching chat persona. observed tail p95 latency +48% when arch_hint mismatch happened.

rui: small diag command to get current hint->kernel mapping:
```
redwood-kernelctl list --format=json | jq '.[] | {label, arch_hint, kernels}'
```

sam: i'll add a short unit test to ensure registry validation rejects entries where arch_hint normalizations diverge from kernel labels.

marta: for immediate rollforward i'm going to: 1) enable emission of decision_score and kv_hit_rate to honeycomb (debug-level sampling to keep cost low), 2) add the alert anne suggested, 3) land registry rename fix.

anne: can you add a note in the release channel when you flip the telemetry flag? want to watch dashboards.

marta: will do. thanks all. :thumbsup:
